title: Unfair Sampling of Quantum Annealing in Weighted Graph Bipartitioning Problems
summary: Quantum annealing (QA) is a promising approach for solving combinatorial optimization problems; however, it is known to exhibit unfair sampling, in which degenerate ground states are not sampled with equal probability even for sufficiently long annealing times. Fair sampling is important in applications such as solution diversity assessment and combinatorial counting, yet the mechanism of unfair sampling remains poorly understood, particularly in constrained combinatorial optimization problems. In this work, we investigate unfair sampling of QA in weighted graph bipartitioning problems…
